scripts._comment_presmoke: The gate serves dist/ and never built it, so `npm run smoke` could pass against a build from before the change — a gate that reports on code nobody is shipping. npm runs this automatically before `smoke`.
scripts.smoke: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD":/work -w /work --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.56.0-noble node smoke.mjs
